messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 02 Aug 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Peregrine hosted API pricing - authorization request

Team — forwarding a customer request that needs exec-level rate authorization (>20%). High level:
- Account: PeregrineAI (startup, healthcare analytics)
- Ask: 30% off standard Hosted API usage rates for a 24-month committed deal (projected invoice run-rate $1.2M year 1, $1.8M year 2 with expansion).
- Rationale from customer: multi-region deployment, guaranteed throughput, strict latency SLOs, and willingness to do a public case study and co-marketing.
- Customer wants final pricing by EOD tomorrow to lock their board approval cycle.

Attached: Peregrine_MA_plan.xlsx (mutual action plan).

Q: I need a formal revenue/impact estimate and recommendation (ben/rishi), and if possible sign-off path (who on the leadership bench can clear 30%?).

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Aug 2028 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Peregrine hosted API pricing - authorization request

Karthik — thanks for the heads-up. A few quick asks so I understand the risk: 
1) Is the $1.2M run-rate net of the proposed discount or gross?
2) What T&Cs or SSO/data residency asks are they attaching? Legal will need to scope.
3) Do we have an outlined onboarding cost or free credits they're requesting?

If this is gross, a 30% concession is material but possible for strategic plays. Send me the MA plan and the expected monthly token volumes so Rishi can run the margin impact. For approval path — Marissa typically authorizes up to 25% in unusual cases; beyond that I need either VP Sales or CFO/Finance sign-off. Let's get the math and draft a conditional approval template (commit terms, no credits, QBRs).

- Ben

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 02 Aug 2028 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Peregrine hosted API pricing - authorization request

Attaching a quick pricing impact calc (pricing_impact_calc.xlsx). Summary: 
- Baseline ARR (list price) year-1: $1,200,000. 30% discount reduces invoiced ARR to $840,000 — delta $360,000 year-1.
- Gross margin hit (estimated): ~22% of delta in year-1 given our expected infra and support costs; incremental margins improve in year-2 as volume ramps and infra utilization increases.
- Net present value across the 24-month deal (conservative churn assumption 5%): still positive for Redwood due to commitment and expected expansion.

Recommendations: 
- Approve up to 30% only if customer signs a 24-month committed MRC with minimum annual spend clauses (min ARR for year-1 $840k), and prepayment or quarterly billing required for year-1.
- No free trial credits; onboarding professional services should be billable.
- Include an automatic uplift clause after month 12 if volume exceeds forecast by >30%.

If leadership wants to push beyond 30% I recommend pairing with a non-refundable onboarding fee to offset initial margin.

- Rishi (Finance)

On Thu, 02 Aug 2028 at 11:03, Ben Carter wrote: 
> Karthik — thanks for the heads-up.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Peregrine hosted API pricing - authorization request

Team — reviewed the MA plan and Rishi's calc. I can authorize a 30% Hosted API rate concession for PeregrineAI under the following mandatory conditions: 
1) 24-month committed MRC with minimum year-1 invoice of $840,000 (post-discount).
2) Quarterly prepaid billing for year-1 (to protect cash and reduce churn risk).
3) No onboarding or trial credits; professional services billed separately.
4) Legal to insert data residency and SOC2 access clauses as requested; Redwood standard security addendum to apply.
5) Mandatory QBR cadence and a 90-day written termination clause (customer cannot cancel earlier without paying remaining committed MRC pro-rated).
6) Revenue clawback: if customer reduces usage by >40% vs forecast in first 12 months without formal change request, we reserve the right to recoup part of the concession.

I will sign the Redwood_approval_form.pdf and authorize Ben/Karthik to finalize commercial terms with the customer. This authorization is timeboxed — acceptance required by EOD Monday, 07 Aug 2028, otherwise the concession expires.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
